E2512

Matrix multiplication needs equal inner sides, but these are {left_inner} and {right_inner}

What

Matrix multiplication needs equal inner sides, but these are {left_inner} and {right_inner}

Why

The left column measure must match the right row measure

Fix

use `Matrix<{left_rows}, {left_inner}> * Matrix<{left_inner}, {right_cols}>`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2512: tests/ui/matrix_measure_inner_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E2512]: matrix multiplication needs equal inner sides, but these are 4 and 5
  --> tests/ui/matrix_measure_inner_mismatch.jet:3:12
    |
  3 |     bad :: left * right
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the left column measure must match the right row measure
 Fix: use `Matrix<3, 4> * Matrix<4, 2>`
